item.title: 'The symbol of the occupation': Ukraine destroys span of Kerch Bridge linking Russia with Crimea
item.description:
A picture taken on July 17, 2023, shows a Russian warship sailing near the Kerch bridge, which links the Russian mainland to Crimea, following an attack claimed by Ukrainian forces. —STRINGER––AFP/Getty Images An overnight Ukrainian missile attack has severely damaged the vital Kerch bridge linking occupied Crimea with Russia, delivering a symbolic blow to Russian President Vladimir Putin ahead of a summit in Asia where he is expected to meet President Donald Trump . The road and rail bridge was built after Russia invaded and annexed the Crimean peninsula in 2014 and connects Crimea to Russia's southern Krasnodar region. Ukrainian officials shared videos on social media that appeared to show a missile strike on the bridge and an entire section of the structure collapsing. item.title: ICE agents shove and pepper-spray pregnant woman
item.description:
Jose Rosito Roca Estrada and his friends were on their way to work in a van on June 27, when a car in front of them slammed on its brakes, forcing them to crash into it and ricochet backward on the busy highway. Three more cars surrounded theirs, and an estimated 10 to 12 officers poured out. The agents screamed at the men to get out of the vehicle despite traffic whipping by, Roca Estrada and fellow passenger Elvis Manuel Mejia told The Intercept. The stalemate ended with the sound of shattering glass and an asphyxiating cloud of chemicals flooding the car. According to a new federal lawsuit and photos from the scene shared with The Intercept, federal agents smashed the car’s back windows and “sprayed the occupants with pepper spray through the lowered side windows.” Officers then dragged a scared and temporarily blinded Roca Estrada from the car. “I was afraid they might be robbing…

item.title: Prosecutors allege man ‘destroyed’ US military plane at Irish airport
item.description:
Daithi O’Corrain charged with destruction of US government property, after allegedly smashing gauges and cutting hydraulic lines An axe-wielding man breached a security perimeter and destroyed an American military plane while it was parked at an Irish airport, US prosecutors said. Daithi O’Corrain, 48, is accused of cutting hydraulic lines, smashing cockpit gauges and pouring ball bearings into fuel tanks. Continue reading...

item.description:
